generalSituation: Winds will be weak over Guangdong tomorrow, it will be mainly fine and very hot over the region. A northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China gradually later tomorrow. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Champi will move across the seas east of Luzon in the next couple of days. It will then have a higher chance of turning northwards and move across the East China Sea over the seas east of Taiwan. It will also have a chance of edging closer to the vicinity of Taiwan to Fujian. The outer subsiding air of Champi will bring fine, very hot and very dry weather to southern China in the latter part of this week. Another surge of northeast monsoon is expected to affect Guangdong early next week.
